reviews.text: Friendly service and professional support for my dog, Peanut Butter, who had a good grooming experience. I will be coming back again to Scenthound.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely Incredible Experience!

A special shout-out to the manager, Bri, who stepped in and truly made it all happen—your exceptional customer service does not go unnoticed! And of course, a huge thank you to Ellie and Marcela for being so attentive, loving, and keeping such a watchful, caring eye on them during their visit.
The entire team went above and beyond, and we will definitely be back. If you want your pets treated like family, this is the place to go! Thank you!!

Such a great experience for Coco! 🐶✨

This new grooming spot nearby the Village of Merrick Park in Coral Gables treated her like an absolute princess from start to finish.
The team was incredibly kind, attentive, and made sure she felt comfortable the entire time.

Coco has very sensitive skin and allergies to many products, so I really appreciated how careful they were in using a hypoallergenic lemon-scented shampoo that smelled amazing and worked perfectly for her. They even took adorable pictures of her after grooming, which made the experience feel extra special.

What I also loved is that they offer monthly membership services, and I signed up right away. Their pricing is honestly very affordable compared to other grooming places around the area, especially considering the level of care and attention they provide.

You can truly tell they care about the pets they treat, and they do a fantastic job.
Highly recommend for anyone looking for a caring, professional, and reasonably priced grooming experience for their dogs or cats! 🐾 when you go tell them Flavia Sent You!

We’ve only had a couple of visits, but so far I’ve been very impressed. My dog comes back clean and relaxed, and she clearly feels comfortable there.

Scenthound—especially the Coral Gables team—has truly been a saving grace for our family. The level of care, consistency, and attention to detail they give is outstanding. My two dogs are always so excited to go in, and they come out happy, relaxed, and squeaky clean every single time.

Bri, Kat, and the entire front-of-house team greet us each week with genuine warmth and incredible customer service, and the groomers are thoughtful, patient, and clearly experts at what they do. We trust them implicitly with our dogs.

What really sets this location apart, though, is how deeply they care. When we lost our other dog, the team reached out with the most compassionate, empathetic words—and a gesture that meant more to us than they could ever know. It wasn’t just professional kindness; it felt truly personal, like they were mourning alongside us.

If you’re looking for a grooming spa that treats your pets like family, this is it. We are so grateful to have them. 🐾

I’m 100% a huge fan of scent hound coral gables!! My husky gets groomed monthly and when I tell you she has never looked better, and smelled great. Most groomers aren’t the best with double coated breeds and I’m often returned with my dog smelling like moist wet dog smell, but here she looked and smelled great. Her coat was soft and she was not losing a single hair!! I highly recommend to anyone who has a double coated breed and needs people with gentle caring hands. She came home so happy! I will definitely be returning and signing up for their very affordable pet packages!! Thank you Scenthound!!

Very friendly and knowledgeable

So happy about our first visit!! We have a 5 month Great Dane puppy and are excited to get her used to having her nails clipped, teeth cleaned, bathed etc. Our pup was super thrilled from the get go (all female staff :) ) Kat (I hope that’s her name) was super friendly and kind, so was the other lady, making it even easier to drop off our little fur baby for her first time. We signed up for the monthly unlimited package ! Highly recommended 10/10

We recently moved to Miami not knowing if we would ever find a groomer that our little man loved, and we lucked out with our first try at Scenthound!

The Coral Gables staff is incredibly warm & caring!  I see this every time in their actions to love on the fur babies as soon as they walk in the door.  We also highly recommend their membership program to simplify your life, and keep on track with any and all of your needs.

You should immediately contact Bri if you want  🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 service.... Archie's smiling face says it all! 🦮🥰

I highly recommend Scenthound for their grooming services. The facility is immaculate, the staff are kind, helpful and caring, and they do a wonderful job with my Golden Retriever. He is so clean and looks amazing when I pick him up!

I have always personally groomed my Golden at home, but due to a recent back injury, I needed to find a reputable groomer for baths. It was nearly impossible to find a local groomer that just offered bath & blow dry without an entire haircut package that costs an arm and a leg. Enter Scenthound: bath and blow dry at a VERY reasonable price, without pushing any unnecessary services to hike up the cost. I really appreciate this aspect.

At 6 years old, I was worried that my Golden would be stressed going to the groomer for the first time. The lovely staff at Scenthound made my dog feel so comfortable and safe, and sent me adorable photos to show me how well he was doing. When I picked him up it was clear that he loved the staff.

We’ve been twice now and they do such a great job with thoroughly cleaning and drying his coat, and making him look his best. I love that they do a full wellness check, which can let me know of any potential external health concerns. I also appreciate that they work quick and efficiently, so my dog doesn’t have to spend half his day at the groomer.

I have high standards and Scenthound has made me a very happy customer. I will be returning on a monthly basis even after my back injury heals, because I am THAT satisfied with Scenthound’s work.
Great service! Everyone at the Coral Gables location were so kind and knowledgeable. It was our first time with ScentHound and we will definitely be back!

I cannot recommend this grooming spot enough! From the moment we walk in, Mooza (our Bernedoodle) is literally peeing of excitement — that’s how much she loves the crew there! 🐾💖

The team is incredibly kind, patient, and genuinely loving with every pup that walks through the door. Mooza is always treated like royalty, and it’s so clear that she adores them right back. Her tail starts wagging the second we pull into the parking spot, and she practically drags me to the door!

Not only is the service amazing, but Mooza always comes home looking and smelling fantastic. I trust them completely and am so grateful we found such a warm and talented team.

Thank you for taking such wonderful care of our girl. You’ve got a fan (and a furry one!) for life! 🐶✨

I’m very upset because I trusted this place to make my dog look nice and well cared for, and it was the complete opposite. I won’t be coming back and I don’t recommend it.
